card.name: Dose word after daily or effective
card.fires_on: The word dose or dosage (or its start, Dos) right after an adjective like daily, effective, starting or maximum in dosing instructions. Also fires on a unit such as µg or percent after a number.

modes.label: Dose after a qualifier
modes.description: The noun dose or dosage following words like daily, starting, maximum or lowest effective.
modes.example: Use the lowest effective<< dosage>> needed to maintain therapeutic response

modes.label: Unit after a number
modes.description: A unit word such as µg or percent right after a quantity.
modes.example: Ovidrel ® PreFilled Syringe 250 µ<<g>> should be administered one day following the last

card.writes: It adds little clear output; the promoted tokens loosely relate to size or sizing.
card.plain: It lights up on the word dose or dosage when a phrase like daily dose or lowest effective dosage is being written.
